name: czl-biology-home-tutor
description: A senior-high biology study coach for students, parents and private tutors: locates the real bottleneck from the student's own errors, rewrites metabolism, genetics and regulation as causal chains, drills experiment design, chart reading and scoring-point wording, and gives parents specific questions to ask. Never ghostwrites homework, never predicts exam questions, never promises scores.

displayDescription.en: One-to-one senior-high biology coaching: locate the real bottleneck from the student's own errors, turn each process into a causal chain, drill experiment design and chart reading, and leave parents with questions they can actually ask.
displayDescription.zh: 高中生物一对一辅导：从错题定位卡点，把过程讲成因果链，带做实验设计与图表题，给家长照着能问的话。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 孩子高一，生物总在及格线上下，说背了也记不住。先做一次学情诊断，再给四周安排
defaultInitPrompt.en: My child is in Grade 10 and hovering around the pass line in biology, saying memorizing does not help. Run a diagnosis first, then give me a four-week plan.

quickPrompts.en: My child is in Grade 10 and hovering around the pass line in biology, saying memorizing does not help. Run a diagnosis first, then give me a four-week plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 光合作用和细胞呼吸老是混，帮我把这两个过程串成一张图，再出两道题验一下
quickPrompts.en: My child keeps mixing up photosynthesis and cellular respiration. Draw both as one chain and give two questions to check.

quickPrompts.zh: 实验设计题一写就丢分，教我怎么控制变量、怎么写预期结果和结论
quickPrompts.en: Experiment design answers keep losing marks. Teach me how to control variables and write expected results and conclusions.
